titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire principal de projet - Investissements dans l'infrastructure (Caraïbes)

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

We are seeking a high-caliber, dedicated PMO Lead / Senior Project Manager to oversee a strategic infrastructure investment project in the Caribbean, while establishing governance and execution discipline across current and future projects in the investment pipeline.
This role carries full accountability for project delivery, spanning finance, construction, commercial, operational, HR, regulatory, and stakeholder dimensions. The successful candidate will act as the single point of coordination and control between investors, contractors, operators, lenders, and government stakeholders.

Your Impact

• Establish and lead a Project Management System, including governance, reporting, controls, and KPIs.
• Drive end-to-end execution of major infrastructure projects, from development through construction and into operations.
• Oversees construction delivery and project financials, including budgets, cash flow, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, lender requirements, and reporting.
• Lead commercial and contract management, supplier, and concession PPP agreements.
• Ensure operational readiness and handover, including systems, staffing, and procedures.
• Coordinate HR and workforce planning, ensuring compliance with local labor laws and effective contractor management.
• Identify and manage project risks across technical, financial, regulatory, ESG, and political dimensions.
• Provide PMO oversight and execution support for additional projects in the development funnel.

Your Journey so far

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Business, or related field; Master’s degree preferred.
• 15+ years of experience in large-scale infrastructure or real asset projects.
• Demonstrated leadership of complex, capital-intensive projects with multiple stakeholders.
• Strong experience across construction, project finance, commercial contracts, and operations.
• Experience in emerging markets and/or the Caribbean region strongly preferred.
• PMP / PRINCE2 or equivalent certification preferred.

Your Essentials

• Hands-on, structured, and highly accountable
• Executive presence and credibility with senior stakeholders
• Comfortable working in complex, multi-jurisdictional environments
• Willing to travel and be on-site as required

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!
descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo scopo

Stiamo cercando un PMO Lead / Senior Project Manager dedicato ad alto livello per supervisionare un progetto di investimento infrastrutturale strategico nei Caraibi, mentre istituisce la disciplina di governance e esecuzione attraverso progetti attuali e futuri nella pipeline di investimento.
Questo ruolo ha piena responsabilità per la consegna del progetto, la finanza, la costruzione, commerciale, operativo, le risorse umane, le normative e le dimensioni degli stakeholder. Il candidato di successo agirà come unico punto di coordinamento e controllo tra investitori, appaltatori, operatori, prestatori e parti interessate del governo.

Il tuo impatto

• Stabilire e guidare un sistema di gestione dei progetti, tra cui governance, reporting, controlli e KPI.
• Guidare l'esecuzione end-to-end di grandi progetti infrastrutturali, dallo sviluppo attraverso la costruzione e le operazioni.
• Supera la consegna delle costruzioni e la finanza di progetto, inclusi budget, cash flow, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, requisiti di credito e reporting.
• Condurre accordi commerciali e contrattuali, fornitori e concessioni PPP.
• Assicurare la disponibilità operativa e la consegna, compresi sistemi, personale e procedure.
• Coordinare la pianificazione delle risorse umane e della forza lavoro, assicurando il rispetto delle leggi sul lavoro locali e la gestione efficace degli appaltatori.
• Identificare e gestire i rischi di progetto attraverso dimensioni tecniche, finanziarie, regolamentari, ESG e politiche.
• Fornire supporto di supervisione e esecuzione PMO per ulteriori progetti nell'imbuto di sviluppo.

Il tuo viaggio finora

• Corso di laurea in Ingegneria, Finanza, Business o campo correlato; Master’s laurea preferito.
• 15 anni di esperienza in infrastrutture su larga scala o progetti di asset reali.
• Dimostrata leadership di progetti complessi e ad alta intensità di capitale con più stakeholder.
• Forte esperienza tra costruzione, project finance, contratti commerciali e operazioni.
• L'esperienza nei mercati emergenti e/o nella regione caraibica ha fortemente preferito.
• PMP / PRINCE2 o equivalente certificazione preferita.

I tuoi essenziali

• Mani su, strutturato e altamente responsabile
• Presenza e credibilità esecutivo con gli stakeholder senior
• Confortevole lavoro in ambienti complessi e multi-giurisdizionali
• Volontà di viaggiare ed essere in loco come richiesto

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!
descriptionByLocale.de:

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

The Senior Digital Acquisition Manager will be responsible for leading the digital marketing strategy across all MSC Cruises markets, with a focus on driving direct sales through digital advertising levers, setting and achieving KPIs, and developing innovative digital campaigns across multiple channels. The successful candidate will have a proven track record in performance marketing and digital sales development at a positive ROAS, along with strong expertise in digital advertising campaign strategy, paid media planning and implementation, and team leadership. Additionally, the role will involve developing affiliation and partnership programs as part of an integrated digital engagement strategy to broaden reach, drive qualified traffic, and support long-term customer value.

Your Impact

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with MSC stakeholders across various markets, with a deep understanding of their business needs, challenges, and opportunities—while balancing the global objectives set by headquarters.

• Set and achieve KPIs for online sales through digital advertising levers, ensuring the media agency delivers against targets and contractual obligations.

• Lead internal meetings, QBRs, and annual reviews by providing strategic insights and recommendations based on campaign performance, website analytics, market trends, and the competitive landscape.

• Plan and implement innovative performance marketing campaigns across Paid Search, Display, Social, Native, Digital Audio, and Video channels—tailored to business goals and market dynamics.

• Collaborate with internal teams—including Creative, Social Media, Data & Analytics, SEO, Content, Product, and agency partners—to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality assets aligned with annual digital sales targets.

• Identify and pursue opportunities to enhance revenue streams through existing and new digital strategies, while improving campaign ROAS and experimenting with innovations in the adtech and martech ecosystem.

• Develop and manage lead generation strategies, ensuring effective customer acquisition flows and nurturing tactics are in place across all paid media touchpoints.

• Maintain oversight of account resourcing and profitability to ensure HQ and local markets are managed efficiently and profitably.

• Serve as the main escalation point for concerns raised by internal teams or local market stakeholders.

• Continuously review and optimize operational workflows, proposing and implementing process improvements where relevant.

• Collaborate with country and HQ stakeholders to prepare and manage the annual digital marketing budget, aligned with MSC Cruises’ B2C revenue goals.

• Lead and optimize affiliate and partnership programs to drive qualified traffic and conversions, ensuring alignment with digital acquisition strategy and performance goals.

• Manage key partners and co-branded initiatives, coordinating with internal teams to ensure seamless execution and tracking.

Your Journey so far

• 7+ years of experience in a similar role.
• Hands-on experience with analytics and ad server tools such as GA4, Adobe Analytics, Campaign Manager and their relevant reporting frameworks.
• Proven experience in managing, mentoring, and upskilling team members.
• Past experience in lead generation strategy and execution is a strong plus.
• Solid experience in budget ownership and cost control.

Your Essentials

• Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus).
• Strong analytical skills and the ability to leverage data for informed decision-making.
• Proven track record of driving direct sales growth and improving ROAS through high-performing digital advertising campaigns.
• Passion for digital marketing, performance media, and innovative digital solutions.
• Deep knowledge of Google and Meta ad platforms, including setup auditing, implementation, and performance analysis with actionable insights.
• Excellent organizational, project management, and problem-solving skills.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office and data visualization tools such as Datorama.
• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams and external partners.
• Ability to identify trends in data and transform insights into actionable strategic recommendations.
• Self-starter with the ability to work independently and take initiative.
• Confident, articulate presenter—comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders and internal teams.
• Strong strategic thinking, capable of acting as a ‘Trusted Advisor’ to senior leadership.
• High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
• Positive attitude, proactive mindset, and a drive to embrace new challenges.
• Knowledge of affiliate platforms such as Awin, Kwanko, and similar tools. Strong network of industry contacts to initiate partnership opportunities and brand collaborations.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Durch die Nutzung der hundertjährigen maritimen Expertise unserer Muttergesellschaft MSC Group wird unsere Flotte von sechs Luxusschiffen (derzeit vier in der Pipeline) auf eine völlig andere und einzigartige Weise gebaut und entworfen, die das Kreuzfahrterlebnis verändern und neu definieren und eine eigene Kategorie schaffen wird, die die nächste Generation von Luxusreisenden anspricht.

Eine aufregende Gelegenheit besteht für einen talentierten, fachkundigen, strategischen und hoch organisierten Fachmann mit starkem kommerziellem Scharfsinn, sich unserer neu geschaffenen Luxusreisemarke Explora Journeys anzuschließen, die in unseren Büros in Genf, Schweiz, ansässig ist.

Das Ziel der Rolle ist es, die DTC-Leistung zu optimieren, Schlüsselhebel zu identifizieren und zu steuern, die Conversion-Rate zu erhöhen, um Kanaleinnahmen, Effektivität und Effizienz zu steigern.

Eigenständig für die Entwicklung, Verfolgung und Aktionierung wichtiger KPIs.

- Steigerung der Effizienz durch Quantifizierung von ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA nach Subkanal nach Markt, um die Investitionen kontinuierlich zu optimieren. Empfehlen Sie Reinvestitionen in Richtung der höchsten Auswirkungen Kanäle.

- Entwicklung von Attributionsmodellen zur Identifizierung von Kanalhebeln, die den Umsatz steigern.

- Erstellen und pflegen Sie B2C Performance Scorecards nach Markt, um die B2C Channel Performance zu überwachen und zu optimieren und so Drop-Off-Punkte zu identifizieren. Sowohl auf Excel als auch in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Unternehmensteam, um es in Self-Service-Tools (Power BI) verfügbar zu machen.

- Partnerschaft mit Media, Digital, Commercial, Revenue, IT, Call Center und Future Sales, um Customer Journeys zu verbessern, Reibungen zu reduzieren, Conversion, Repeat und Customer Lifetime Value zu erhöhen.

- Wettbewerbsanalyse: Überwachung von Marktbedingungen, Wettbewerbsaktivitäten und Branchentrends zur Unterstützung der strategischen Planung und Identifizierung von Differenzierungs- und Wachstumsmöglichkeiten.

- Bereiten Sie führungsbereite Präsentationen mit klaren datenbasierten Empfehlungen vor, um die strategische Entscheidungsfindung in der Geschäftsleitung zu unterstützen, indem Sie die Visualisierung stellarer Daten mit tiefen Einblicken kombinieren.

Deine Reise bisher

- Präferenz für vorherige Erfahrungen in der Luxus-Hospitality / Reisebranche oder Beratungsagenturen.

- Bachelor-Abschluss in Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Commercial oder verwandten Bereichen (Masters, MBA oder gleichwertige Erfahrung bevorzugt).

Ihre Essentials

- Hervorragende PowerPoint- und Storytelling-Fähigkeiten - in der Lage, saubere, klare und wirkungsvolle Präsentationen für das C-Suite-Publikum zu erstellen.

- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics oder ähnlichen Plattformen sowie BI- und Visualisierungstools wie Tableau, Power BI, Looker oder ähnlichen Plattformen.

- Kenntnis der Direktverkaufskanäle

- Hervorragende schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. fließend in Englisch.

- Leidenschaft und Neugier, sich ständig über die sich ständig weiterentwickelnde Reisebranche zu informieren.

Bei Explora Journeys definieren wir Luxus-Ozeanreisen neu - wo Entdeckung, Wohlbefinden und ein tiefer Respekt für die Meere in Harmonie zusammenkommen.
Wir suchen leidenschaftliche Profis, die unsere Vision einer immersiveren, transformativeren Art und Weise teilen, die inspirierendsten Reiseziele der Welt auf dem Seeweg zu entdecken.

Où la passion rencontre des opportunités

Découvrez votre voyage dans l'extraordinaire.

Votre but

Explora Journeys est une marque de luxe européenne dynamique et cosmopolite, imaginée au cœur de l'hospitalité suisse à Genève. Tirant parti de notre société mère MSC Group de centaines d'années d'expertise maritime, notre flotte de six navires de luxe (quatre actuellement dans le pipeline) sont en cours de construction et de conception d'une manière totalement différente et unique qui transformera et redéfinira l'expérience de croisière, créant une catégorie propre, attrayant pour la prochaine génération de voyageurs de luxe.

Une opportunité passionnante s'offre à un professionnel talentueux, compétent en analyse, stratégique et hautement organisé avec une forte acuité commerciale pour rejoindre notre nouvelle marque de voyage de luxe Explora Journeys, basée dans nos bureaux à Genève, Suisse.

Votre impact

L'objectif du rôle est d'optimiser le rendement du CIPH, d'identifier et de piloter les leviers clés, d'augmenter le taux de conversion pour stimuler les revenus, l'efficacité et l'efficience des canaux.
Optimiser la performance des entreprises directes à consommateurs en identifiant et en activant les principaux leviers de croissance qui améliorent la production de revenus sur les marchés et les sous-canaux d'affaires à consommateurs (B2C), la conversion, l'efficacité des canaux et l'efficience opérationnelle et d'investissement.

- Analyse des performances : suivre et analyser les performances par rapport aux KPI de canaux et commerciaux, fournir des informations et des recommandations spécifiques à chaque canal par marché pour maximiser les revenus par sous-canal B2C (Web, Call Centre et Future Sales) et favoriser l'amélioration continue. Posséder le développement, le suivi et l'action des principaux ICR.

- Conduire l'efficacité, quantifier ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA par sous-canal par marché pour optimiser continuellement les investissements. Recommander des réinvestissements vers des canaux à plus fort impact.

- Élaborer des modèles d'attribution pour identifier les leviers de canaux qui génèrent des revenus.

- Construisez et maintenez des fiches de rendement B2C par marché pour surveiller et optimiser les performances des canaux B2C, en identifiant les points de chute. À la fois sur Excel et en partenariat avec l'équipe d'entreprise pour le rendre disponible dans des outils en libre-service (Power BI).

- Partenaire avec Media, Digital, Commercial, Revenu, IT, Call Centre et Future Sales afin d'améliorer les voyages des clients, de réduire les frictions, d'augmenter la conversion, de répéter et la valeur de vie du client.

- Analyse concurrentielle : surveiller les conditions du marché, les activités concurrentielles et les tendances de l'industrie pour appuyer la planification stratégique et identifier les possibilités de différenciation et de croissance.

- Préparer des présentations prêtes pour les cadres supérieurs, avec des recommandations claires fondées sur des données pour appuyer la prise de décisions stratégiques par les cadres supérieurs, en tirant parti de la visualisation des données stellaires combinée à la profondeur des connaissances.

Votre voyage jusqu'à présent

- 5+ ans d'expérience en analyse commerciale, intelligence d'affaires, analyse DTC ou performance eCommerce.

- Préférence pour une expérience antérieure dans l'industrie de l'hôtellerie de luxe/voyage ou les agences de conseil.

- Baccalauréat en affaires, économie, finances, marketing, commercial ou domaine connexe (maîtrise, MBA ou expérience équivalente préférée).

Vos essentiels

- Expérience éprouvée pour soutenir les cadres supérieurs et prospérer dans un environnement de démarrage rapide, gérer simultanément plusieurs priorités.

- Excellentes compétences d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes avec la capacité de traduire des données complexes en aperçus opérationnels concrets.

- Très compétent en Excel et en manipulant confortablement les données de gros ensembles de données et en maintenant de grands tableurs avec un haut niveau de précision

- Des compétences exceptionnelles en PowerPoint et en narration – capables d'élaborer des présentations propres, nettes et à impact élevé pour les auditoires C-suite.

- Expérience de travail avec Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics ou des plateformes similaires, ainsi que des outils BI et de visualisation tels que Tableau, Power BI, Looker ou des plateformes similaires.

- Connaissance des circuits de vente directe

- Excellente capacité de communication écrite et verbale. En anglais.

- Passion et curiosité d'apprendre continuellement sur l'industrie du voyage en constante évolution.

À Explora Journeys, nous redéfinissons le voyage de luxe dans l'océan, où la découverte, le bien-être et le profond respect des mers s'unissent en harmonie.
Nous recherchons des professionnels passionnés qui partagent notre vision d'une façon plus immersive et transformatrice de découvrir les destinations les plus inspirantes du monde par la mer.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

Lead and define the strategic planning, deployment, and operational management of the Multimedia Department while supporting audiovisual (AV) systems across fleet and corporate infrastructure. Oversee fleet multimedia content, technology innovation, and AV operations to maximise guest experience and maintain consistent brand standards. Working closely with global teams, new build projects, and external stakeholders, drive collaboration across Entertainment, Marketing, IT, Digital, Production, and technical functions to deliver seamless digital experiences. The AV scope expands beyond traditional multimedia, supporting wider technical initiatives across the Entertainment division — including theatrical and guest activities — and acting as a key bridge between operational entertainment needs and technical delivery teams.

Your Impact

- Manage multimedia and AV operations, including the design, implementation, optimisation, and lifecycle management of audio, video, broadcast, digital signage, and content delivery systems.

- Partner with shoreside and onboard technical teams to ensure equipment reliability, structured maintenance planning, operational scheduling, and agreed repair strategies across the fleet.

- Lead cross-functional initiatives with Entertainment, Marketing, IT, Digital, Production, and technical stakeholders to deliver innovative onboard and shoreside guest experiences.

- Act as the primary liaison between Entertainment, Production vendors, external contractors, and the Show and Multimedia department, translating creative and operational requirements into scalable technical solutions.

- Advise and support New Build projects on multimedia and AV technical requirements, ensuring future-proof, sustainable technology integration.

- Collaborate with Brand, Marketing, and content providers to develop, brief, and implement new ship-based media content strategies and onboard marketing initiatives.

- Define and project manage operational workflows and delivery plans for Entertainment and onboard marketing content across shipboard screens and digital platforms.

- Oversee vendor relationships, procurement activities, and associated budgets to maintain cost efficiency while ensuring technical excellence.

- Monitor and evaluate global technology trends to keep fleet systems innovative, competitive, and aligned with evolving guest expectations.

- Develop, maintain, and continuously improve standard operating procedures and technical standards, ensuring fleetwide consistency, safety, and operational efficiency in line with corporate Entertainment guidelines.

- Supervise, appraise, and mentor ship-based and touring technicians globally, ensuring compliance with safety, maritime, and corporate policies.

- Support live events, broadcasting, corporate communications, and multimedia initiatives through strategic planning combined with hands-on technical leadership.

- Manage and govern visual content provided by internal and external partners for broadcast across onboard platforms.

Your Journey so far

- Extensive experience within cruise environments is a must.

- Senior operational and managerial experience within the Entertainment industry.

- Mother tongue English; Italian, German, or Spanish advantageous.

- Strong background in broadcasting, web, TV, theatrical production, or digital media operations with managerial responsibility.

- Knowledge of enterprise Content Management Systems and digital platforms.

- Solid IT literacy with understanding of systems architecture and AV integration.

- Full understanding of LES systems within the maritime industry.

- Advanced computer literacy (Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Suite, and CAD software).

- Strong project management and stakeholder coordination skills.

- Proven ability to work autonomously, solve complex operational challenges, and manage global teams.

- International mindset with experience supporting mixed-nationality audiences and global operations.

- Willingness to travel extensively.

Your Essentials

- SWISS Resident or Visa Holder

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it: Il tuo scopo Il Direttore Finanze e Contabilità – Nuovi Investimenti porterà la supervisione finanziaria, la contabilità e la gestione delle prestazioni per i nuovi Investimenti Strategic Value Chain (“SVCI”) della società. Questo ruolo gioca un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire forti controlli finanziari e collaborare con team interfunzionali per ottimizzare la redditività attraverso operazioni di crociera non core. Il candidato ideale porta una miscela di competenze di contabilità tecnica, finanza commerciale acumen, e l'esperienza di sostenere gli ambienti orientati agli investimenti o multi-business. Il tuo impatto Gestione finanziaria e reporting - Controllare la contabilità, fine mese vicino, e la rendicontazione finanziaria per SVCI - Assicurare il riconoscimento accurato dei ricavi, l'allocazione dei costi e l'analisi dei margini per SVCI - Preparare e rivedere rapporti di gestione, KPI e analisi di varianza per sostenere le decisioni aziendali - Mantenere il rispetto dei controlli interni, degli standard contabili e delle politiche aziendali Nuovi investimenti e valutazione aziendale - Traccia le prestazioni post-investimento rispetto al piano e identifica rischi e opportunità di miglioramento Bilancio e previsione - Assistere gli investimenti e il gruppo durante i processi di budget e rolling forecast - Partner con i leader operativi per sviluppare ipotesi realistiche e obiettivi finanziari - Monitorare le prestazioni contro i bilanci e fornire informazioni attuabili Supporto trasversale - Agire come partner finanziario per sostenere potenziali sinergie all'interno degli investimenti. - Collaborare con i team legali, del Tesoro, delle Operazioni e Commerciali su strutture contrattuali, modelli di prezzi e implicazioni finanziarie - Supportare iniziative strategiche relative all'espansione, all'innovazione e all'ottimizzazione di nuovi investimenti Miglioramento dei processi e sistemi - Migliorare i processi finanziari, segnalare l'automazione e la qualità dei dati nelle attività di investimento - Supporta l'implementazione o la valorizzazione di ERP, strumenti di reporting o sistemi finanziari secondo le necessità - Identificare le opportunità di scalare i processi di finanza come nuove imprese crescono Il tuo viaggio finora - Laurea magistrale in Finanza, Contabilità o campo relativo (CPA, ACA, ACCA, o equivalente fortemente preferito) con uno sfondo Big 4 - 6-10 anni di esperienza progressiva nella finanza e nella contabilità, compreso l'esposizione agli investimenti, o ambienti multi-entity - Esperienza nell'ospitalità, viaggio, crociera, vendita al dettaglio, servizi di consumo, o le industrie asset-heavy è un vantaggio forte - Solida comprensione della modellazione finanziaria, del bilancio, della previsione e del reporting gestionale - Forte conoscenza dei principi contabili IFRS e dei controlli finanziari - Fluente in inglese, francese e/o italiano sono un plus I tuoi essenziali - Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving con una mentalità commerciale - Capacità di tradurre i dati finanziari in chiare informazioni per gli stakeholder non finanziari - Confortevole lavoro in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione con più stakeholder - Alta attenzione ai dettagli con la capacità di vedere il grande quadro - Ottima comunicazione e capacità di costruzione di relazioni Il nostro impegno Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta. Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!
descriptionByLocale.en: Your Purpose The Finance and Accounting Manager – New Investments will lead financial oversight, accounting, and performance management for the company’s new Strategic Value Chain Investments (“SVCI”). This role plays a critical part in ensuring strong financial controls, and partnering with cross-functional teams to optimize profitability across non-core cruise operations. The ideal candidate brings a blend of technical accounting expertise, commercial finance acumen, and experience supporting investment-driven or multi-business environments. Your Impact Financial Management & Reporting - Oversee accounting, month-end close, and financial reporting for SVCI - Ensure accurate revenue recognition, cost allocation, and margin analysis for SVCI - Prepare and review management reports, KPIs, and variance analyses to support business decisions - Maintain compliance with internal controls, accounting standards, and company policies New Investments & Business Evaluation - Track post-investment performance versus plan and identify risks and improvement opportunities Budgeting & Forecasting - Assist the investments and the group during budgeting and rolling forecast processes - Partner with operational leaders to develop realistic assumptions and financial targets - Monitor performance against budgets and provide actionable insights Cross-Functional Support - Act as a finance business partner to support potential synergies within the investments. - Collaborate with Legal, Treasury, Operations, and Commercial teams on contract structures, pricing models, and financial implications - Support strategic initiatives related to expansion, innovation, and optimization of new investments Process Improvement & Systems - Improve financial processes, reporting automation, and data quality across investment activities - Support implementation or enhancement of ERP, reporting tools, or financial systems as needed - Identify opportunities to scale finance processes as new businesses grow Your Journey so far - descriptionByLocale.fr: Votre but Le gestionnaire des finances et de la comptabilité – Nouveaux investissements dirigera la surveillance financière, la comptabilité et la gestion du rendement de la société. Ce rôle joue un rôle essentiel dans la mise en place de contrôles financiers solides et dans le partenariat avec des équipes interfonctionnelles afin d'optimiser la rentabilité des croisières non essentielles. Le candidat idéal apporte un mélange d'expertise technique en comptabilité, de finance commerciale et d'expérience soutenant des environnements axés sur l'investissement ou multi-entreprises. Votre impact Gestion financière et rapports - Superviser la comptabilité, la clôture du mois et l'information financière pour SVCI - Veiller à la comptabilisation exacte des recettes, à la répartition des coûts et à l'analyse de la marge pour l'ICVV - Préparer et examiner les rapports de gestion, les ICR et les analyses des écarts pour appuyer les décisions opérationnelles - Maintenir le respect des contrôles internes, des normes comptables et des politiques de l'entreprise Nouveaux investissements et évaluation des entreprises - Collaborer avec les dirigeants opérationnels pour élaborer des hypothèses réalistes et des objectifs financiers - Surveiller le rendement par rapport aux budgets et fournir des renseignements concrets Soutien transversal - Soutenir les initiatives stratégiques liées à l'expansion, à l'innovation et à l'optimisation des nouveaux investissements Amélioration des processus et systèmes - Améliorer les processus financiers, l'automatisation des rapports et la qualité des données dans toutes les activités d'investissement - Appuyer la mise en œuvre ou l'amélioration du PGI, des outils d'établissement de rapports ou des systèmes financiers au besoin - Identifier les possibilités d'étendre les processus de financement à mesure que les nouvelles entreprises grandissent Votre voyage jusqu'à présent - Expérience dans les secteurs de l'hôtellerie, des voyages, des croisières, du commerce de détail, des services à la consommation ou des biens lourds est un plus fort - Bonne compréhension de la modélisation financière, de la budgétisation, des prévisions et des rapports de gestion - Haute attention au détail avec la possibilité de voir le grand tableau - Excellentes compétences en communication et en relation Notre engagement Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui valorise les diverses perspectives, embrasse le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être lui-même authentique. descriptionByLocale.it: Il tuo scopo Il Vice President Global SPA and Wellness è il proprietario di business globale per tutte le operazioni di SPA, benessere, bellezza e fitness a bordo della Divisione Crociera di MSC Group, che comprende MSC Cruises (Contemporary & Premium) e Explora Journeys (Luxury). Il ruolo ha piena responsabilità per i programmi SPA e di trattamento, aree fitness e termali, servizi di salone, vendita al dettaglio benessere, estetica medica (dove applicabile), e future offerte di benessere digitale. descriptionByLocale.en: Your Purpose The Vice President Global SPA and Wellness is the global business owner for all onboard SPA, wellness, beauty, and fitness operations across the Cruise Division of MSC Group, spanning MSC Cruises (Contemporary & Premium) and Explora Journeys (Luxury). This position ensures that luxury wellness standards, service rituals, therapeutic excellence, and holistic wellbeing philosophies are fully embedded—particularly for Explora Journeys—while maintaining scalable, brand-differentiated wellness frameworks across the fleet. The VP defines the long-term global SPA and wellness vision, drives commercial performance, elevates guest satisfaction, and evolves wellness concepts that differentiate MSC Group’s Cruise Division across contemporary, premium, and luxury segments. Your Impact Strategic & Commercial Leadership - Define and lead the global SPA and wellness strategy across contemporary, premium, and luxury brands, aligned with differentiated guest profiles and brand positioning. - Act as business owner for Global SPA and Wellness, with explicit accountability for luxury wellness concepts and standards. - Own the end-to-end commercial roadmap, including treatment architecture, pricing strategy, promotions, capacity optimisation, and end-to-end guest journey design. - Lead strategic negotiations with SPA operators, wellness partners, medical aesthetics providers (where permitted), product brands, and equipment suppliers. - Drive growth in high-margin and premium wellness categories, including signature treatments, medical aesthetics, fitness and longevity programs, wellness retail, and personalised wellbeing journeys. - Develop scalable yet brand-distinct SPA and wellness frameworks, enabling selective deployment of premium and luxury concepts across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys. Operational and Brand Excellence - Oversee SPA operations fleet-wide, ensuring consistent service delivery, treatment quality, hygiene standards, and guest satisfaction. - Define service standards, therapist certification requirements, training programs, and performance benchmarks across all SPA formats. - Ensure luxury wellness excellence for Explora Journeys, including service rituals, therapist conduct, holistic programming, privacy standards, and immersive wellness environments. - Introduce tier-specific wellness concepts, signature and luxury rituals, experiential programming, and destination-inspired treatments. - Ensure fleet readiness for newbuilds and dry docks, including SPA layout design, equipment selection, CAPEX planning, and concept activation. Leadership & Organisational Development - Lead a global HQ and fleet SPA and wellness organisation, including strategy, operations, training, and partner management teams. - Build a culture of guest-centric service excellence, luxury wellness stewardship, commercial discipline, and continuous innovation. - Mentor senior leaders and strengthen capabilities across SPA operations, luxury wellness concept development, and data-driven performance management. Your Journey so far - 15+ years senior leadership experience in SPA, wellness, hospitality, cruise, or multi-site service businesses. - Proven success owning complex P&Ls and driving profitability in service-led environments. - Deep expertise in SPA operations, wellness programming, service quality management, and luxury guest experience standards. - Strong experience managing third-party operators, concession models, or global vendor partnerships. Your Essentials - Excellent leadership, negotiation, and cross-functional stakeholder management skills. - Willingness to travel extensively and operate in a fast-paced international environment. Our commitment We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet. Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Il tuo scopo

Unisciti a MSC Crociere per un entusiasmante stage focalizzato su analisi, monitoraggio delle prestazioni e generazione di informazioni in due aree strategiche: Customer Journey e il nostro miglior programma.

Questo ruolo è ideale per qualcuno appassionato di analisi dei dati, generazione di insight e creazione di dashboard, con un forte interesse a migliorare l'esperienza dei dipendenti e degli ospiti attraverso un impatto misurabile.

Your Purpose

Join MSC Cruises for an exciting internship focused on analytics, performance tracking, and insight generation across two strategic areas: Customer Journey and Our best Programme.

This role is ideal for someone passionate about data analysis, insights generation, and dashboard creation, with a strong interest in improving employee and guest experience through measurable impact.

You will support the development of structured analysis, and follow‑up mechanisms, working closely with Customer Journey and HR department. The role provides hands‑on exposure to both guest‑focused and employee‑focused analytics.

Your Impact

Customer journey:

- Support recurring Customer Journey analyses, including canvas‑based reviews, mid‑season ship‑by‑ship analyses, and committee deliverables.

- Contribute to ad‑hoc deep‑dive analyses on specific topics, guest segments, nationalities, or ships, based on business and management requests.

- Prepare data extractions, charts, tables, and first‑level analytical outputs using standardised templates.

- Maintain Customer Journey analysis trackers, ensuring proper documentation, version control, and monitoring of action plans.

- Support follow‑up analyses and updates after pilots, operational changes, or management feedback.

- Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and alignment across Customer Journey deliverables and reporting.

Our BEST programme:

- Support the development, maintenance, and tracking of KPI frameworks for the OUR BEST programme.

- Consolidate and analyse data from multiple sources, including employee engagement surveys, OUR BEST feedback, training NPS, and relevant guest indicators.

- Build, update, and maintain dashboards to monitor programme performance, engagement, and impact over time.

- Produce regular performance reports and structured executive summaries for leadership reviews.

- Ensure data consistency, accuracy, and reporting standards across all OUR BEST analytics outputs.

- Support the preparation of data visualisations and storytelling materials for senior stakeholders.

Your Journey so far

- Degree (or currently enrolled) in Business, Data Analytics, Hospitality, or a related field

- Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail

- Advanced Excel skills; knowledge of dashboarding tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) is a plus

- Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate data into structured insights

- Fluent in English

Your Essentials

Preferred Skills

-
Basic understanding of guest satisfaction metrics and NPS

-
Basic understanding of employee engagement metrics

- Experience with data visualisation and reporting tools

- Interest in customer journey, guest experience, and service improvement

- Familiarity with survey data analysis and open‑comment analysis

What This Role Offers You:

- Hands-on experience in analytics, KPI development, and dashboarding

- Exposure to real business impact through data-driven decision-making

- Opportunity to work in a global, dynamic environment

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!
descriptionByLocale.de:
Ihr Ziel

Begleiten Sie MSC Cruises für ein spannendes Praktikum, das sich auf Analytik, Performance Tracking und Einblicke in zwei strategische Bereiche konzentriert: Customer Journey und unser bestes Programm.

Diese Rolle ist ideal für jemanden, der über die Datenanalyse, die Einsichten und die Dashboard-Erstellung leiden, mit einem starken Interesse an der Verbesserung der Mitarbeiter- und Gasterfahrung durch messbare Auswirkungen.

Sie unterstützen die Entwicklung strukturierter Analysen und Folgemechanismen, die eng mit der Customer Journey und der Personalabteilung zusammenarbeiten. Die Rolle bietet eine Hand-on-Belichtung sowohl mit gastorientierten als auch mitarbeiterorientierten Analysen.

Ihre Auswirkungen

Customer Journey:

- Unterstützung wiederkehrender Customer Journey-Analysen, einschließlich leinwandbasierter Bewertungen, Zwischensaison Schifffahrtsanalysen und Auslieferungen von Ausschüssen.

- Tragen Sie auf ad‐hoc tief-dive Analysen zu spezifischen Themen, Gastsegmenten, Nationalitäten oder Schiffen basierend auf Geschäfts- und Managementanfragen bei.

- Bereiten Sie Datenextraktionen, Diagramme, Tabellen und Analyseergebnisse auf der ersten Ebene mithilfe standardisierter Vorlagen vor.

- Bewahren Sie Kundenreise-Analyse-Tracker, um eine ordnungsgemäße Dokumentation, Versionskontrolle und Überwachung von Aktionsplänen zu gewährleisten.

- Unterstützung von Folgeanalysen und Aktualisierungen nach Piloten, operativen Änderungen oder Management-Feedbacks.

- Stellen Sie die Datengenauigkeit, Konsistenz und Ausrichtung über die Customer Journey-Auslieferungen und Berichterstattung sicher.

Unser BEST-Programm:

- Unterstützung der Entwicklung, Wartung und Verfolgung von KPI-Rahmen für das OUR BEST-Programm.

- Konsolidieren und Analysieren von Daten aus mehreren Quellen, einschließlich Mitarbeiter-Vermittlungserhebungen, OUR BEST-Feedback, Schulungs-NPS und relevante Gästeindikatoren.

- Erstellen, aktualisieren und pflegen Dashboards, um Programmleistung, Engagement und Auswirkungen im Laufe der Zeit zu überwachen.

- Erstellen Sie regelmäßige Leistungsberichte und strukturierte Zusammenfassungen von Führungskräften.

- Gewährleistung der Datenkonsistenz, Genauigkeit und Berichterstattung über alle OUR BEST-Analyseergebnisse.

- Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Datenvisualisierungen und Storytelling-Materialien für Senior Stakeholder.

Ihre Reise so weit

- Abschluss (oder aktuell eingeschrieben) in Business, Data Analytics, Hospitality oder einem verwandten Bereich

- Starke analytische Denkweise mit Liebe zum Detail

- Erweiterte Excel-Fähigkeiten; Kenntnisse der Dashboarding-Tools (z.B. Power BI, Tableau) ist ein Plus

- Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit der Möglichkeit, Daten in strukturierte Erkenntnisse zu übersetzen

- Fluent auf Englisch

Ihre Essenzen

Bevorzugte Fähigkeiten

- Ja.
Grundverständnis der Gästezufriedenheit Metriken und NPS

- Ja.
Grundverständnis der Mitarbeiterverlobungsmetriken

- Erfahrung mit Datenvisualisierungs- und Reporting-Tools

- Interesse an Customer Journey, Gasterlebnis und Serviceverbesserung

- Vertraulichkeit mit Umfragedatenanalyse und Open-comment-Analyse

Was diese Rolle bietet Ihnen:

- Hand-on-Erfahrung in Analytik, KPI-Entwicklung und Dashboarding

- Exposition gegenüber realen Geschäftsauswirkungen durch datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung

- Möglichkeit, in einem globalen, dynamischen Umfeld zu arbeiten

Unser Engagement

Wir sind verpflichtet, eine Zukunft aufzubauen, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertet, die Welt jenseits der Grenzen umarmt und eine integrative Umgebung fördert, in der jeder Mensch sich wertschätzt, respektiert und befähigt fühlt, seine authentischen Selbst zu sein. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Handlungen, die langfristig positive Auswirkungen auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten haben.

Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Besuchen Sie uns bei MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten erwartet werden. Wenden Sie sich heute an, Teil eines globalen Teams zu sein, das Grenzen drängt und etwas bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Votre but

Rejoignez MSC Cruises pour un stage passionnant axé sur l'analyse, le suivi des performances et la génération de perspicaces dans deux domaines stratégiques : le parcours client et notre meilleur programme.

Ce rôle est idéal pour une personne passionnée par l'analyse des données, la génération de connaissances et la création de tableaux de bord, qui s'intéresse vivement à l'amélioration de l'expérience des employés et des invités grâce à un impact mesurable.

Vous soutiendrez le développement d'analyses structurées et de mécanismes de suivi, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec le service Voyage client et RH. Ce rôle permet d'être directement exposé aux analyses axées sur les clients et les employés.

Votre impact

Voyage client:

- Soutenir les analyses récurrentes du parcours client, y compris les examens sur toile, les analyses en milieu de saison par navire et les produits livrables du comité.

- Contribuer à des analyses ad hoc sur des sujets précis, des segments invités, des nationalités ou des navires, en fonction des demandes d'affaires et de gestion.

- Préparer des extractions de données, des graphiques, des tableaux et des résultats analytiques de premier niveau à l'aide de modèles normalisés.

- Tenir des traceurs d'analyse du parcours client, assurer la documentation appropriée, le contrôle des versions et le suivi des plans d'action.

- Appuyer les analyses de suivi et les mises à jour après les projets pilotes, les changements opérationnels ou la rétroaction de la direction.

- Veiller à l'exactitude, à l'uniformité et à l'alignement des données sur les produits livrables et les rapports du Programme Voyage client.

Notre programme BEST:

- Soutenir le développement, la maintenance et le suivi des cadres KPI pour le programme NOTRE MEILLEUR.

- Consolider et analyser les données provenant de sources multiples, y compris les enquêtes sur l'engagement des employés, NOTRE meilleure rétroaction, la formation des NPF et les indicateurs pertinents des invités.

- Créer, mettre à jour et tenir à jour des tableaux de bord pour surveiller l'exécution, l'engagement et l'impact du programme au fil du temps.

- Produire régulièrement des rapports sur le rendement et des résumés structurés pour les examens des dirigeants.

- Assurer la cohérence des données, l'exactitude et les normes de rapport pour tous nos meilleurs résultats analytiques.

- Soutenir la préparation de visualisations de données et de matériel de narration pour les acteurs de haut niveau.

Votre voyage jusqu'à présent

- Diplôme (ou actuellement inscrit) en Business, Data Analytics, Hospitality, ou un domaine connexe

- Forte mentalité analytique avec attention aux détails

- Compétences Excel avancées; la connaissance des outils de tableau de bord (p. ex. Power BI, Tableau) est un plus

- Fortes compétences en communication, avec la capacité de traduire les données en idées structurées

- Fluent en anglais

Vos essentiels

Compétences privilégiées

- Oui.
Compréhension de base des paramètres de satisfaction des clients et des NPS

- Oui.
Connaissance de base des paramètres de la participation des employés

- Expérience de la visualisation des données et des outils de rapport

- Intérêt pour le voyage client, l'expérience client et l'amélioration du service

- Connaissance de l'analyse des données d'enquête et de l'analyse des commentaires ouverts

Ce que ce rôle vous offre :

- Expérience pratique en analyse, développement KPI et tableau de bord

- Exposition à un impact commercial réel grâce à la prise de décisions fondées sur les données

- Possibilité de travailler dans un environnement mondial et dynamique

Notre engagement

Nous sommes déterminés à bâtir un avenir qui valorise les diverses perspectives, embrasse le monde au-delà des frontières et favorise un environnement inclusif où chaque individu se sent valorisé, respecté et habilité à être lui-même authentique. Notre engagement s'étend à prendre des mesures significatives et mesurables qui ont un impact positif à long terme sur nos invités, nos employés et notre planète.

Prêt à transformer votre passion en quelque chose d'extraordinaire ? Rejoignez-nous au MSC Cruises, où de nouvelles opportunités attendent. Appliquer aujourd'hui pour faire partie d'une équipe mondiale qui repousse les frontières et réalise quelque chose de remarquable. Votre voyage commence ici !

descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose Working at the heart of the business and in close partnership with the Corporate HR team, the Senior HR Business Partner provides strategic and hands-on HR support to assigned corporate functions and offices worldwide, within a fast-paced, service-driven hospitality environment. Reporting to the Head of HR, this role partners with senior leaders to translate business priorities into effective people solutions, while ensuring consistent application of Group HR policies, processes, and standards. The Senior HRBP plays a key role in driving performance, engagement, and organisational effectiveness in a complex, international organisation where operational excellence, agility, and customer focus are critical. Your Impact - Act as the primary HR partner for assigned corporate functions, providing strategic advice and operational HR support aligned with business objectives; - Equip leaders with the tools, frameworks, and guidance required to effectively manage their teams in line with Group values and people policies; - Partner with senior leaders to support workforce planning and organisational needs, ensuring capabilities and capacity are aligned with current and future business requirements; - Collaborate closely with Talent Acquisition and hiring managers to define recruitment needs and support delivery of hiring plans in line with agreed KPIs; - Drive performance and accountability by supporting the implementation of the Group performance management framework, including goal setting, evaluation cycles, and manager capability building; - Support talent management processes within the business perimeter, including talent reviews, identification of high-potential employees, succession discussions, and development actions, in coordination with the Head of HR and relevant Centers of Expertise; - Advise managers on employee relations matters, ensuring fair, consistent, and compliant people decisions; - Support change management and organisational initiatives by assessing people impact, supporting leaders through transitions, and ensuring clear and effective communication; - Contribute to key HR cycles such as annual compensation reviews, talent reviews, and employee engagement initiatives; - Work closely with HR Operations, Payroll, and HRIS teams to ensure smooth execution of HR processes and digital tools; - Participate in global HR projects and initiatives, contributing business insight and supporting effective local implementation; - Conduct exit interviews, analyse turnover trends, and contribute to retention and engagement actions within the business perimeter. Your Journey so far - Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; - Minimum 10 years of progressive HR experience in a matrixed, multinational environment, including at least 5 -7 years in a Senior HR Business Partner or equivalent role; - Proven HR experience within the hospitality, cruise, travel or customer-centric industry, with a strong understanding of service culture; - Demonstrated experience partnering with senior leaders in a corporate or headquarters environment; - Strong project management skills, with the ability to plan, coordinate, and deliver HR initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and tight timelines; - Solid exposure to performance management, talent processes, employee relations, and organisational support; - Experience working with global HR policies, frameworks, and HR systems (HRIS); - Knowledge of Swiss Labour Law is an advantage; - Fluent in English; French is an advantage. Your Essentials - Strong business acumen with the ability to translate strategy into pragmatic HR solutions; - Credible and confident advisor, able to influence, challenge, and build trust with senior stakeholders; - Strong understanding of hospitality and service excellence cultures, with the ability to balance people care, performance, and operational demands; - Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery in a fast-paced, high-expectation environment. - Structured, reliable, and comfortable operating across multiple priorities; - Collaborative mindset, with the ability to work effectively across HR functions and with diverse stakeholders; - High standards of integrity, discretion, and professional judgment; - Flexible, resilient, and solution-oriented, with a continuous improvement mindset. Our commitment We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet. Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

titleByLocale.it: Direttore delle Operazioni - Infrastrutture di accoglienza

descriptionByLocale.it: Il tuo scopo Il Direttore delle Operazioni è responsabile per la progettazione, la mobilitazione, l'apertura e il funzionamento in corso di grandi dimensioni navi da crociera e infrastrutture di ospitalità. Il ruolo assicura la continuità dello sviluppo attraverso operazioni a stato costante, agendo come proprietario operativo dalle prime fasi di costruzione attraverso prestazioni a lungo termine. Lavorando in parallelo con lo sviluppo, la costruzione e l'esperienza degli ospiti, il direttore delle operazioni garantisce che i beni sono operabili dal design, completamente pronti all'apertura e in modo sostenibile, sicuro e redditizio in seguito. Il vostro impatto 1. Leadership operativa Attraverso il ciclo di vita delle risorse proprie responsabilità operativa end-to-end dalla pre-apertura attraverso operazioni dal vivo. Definire la visione operativa a lungo termine, KPI e standard di servizio. Garantire continuità di progettazione, cultura e sistemi dalla fase di progetto alle operazioni a stato costante. 2. Pre-apertura e mobilitazione (Parallel to Construction) Guidare il programma di disponibilità operativa allineato con pietre miliari di costruzione. In coordinamento con Corporate Guest Services (F&B, HK, Entertainment ecc.), definisce le esigenze di Procurements e implementarlo. FFE/OWS. Decisioni di progettazione di influenza per garantire efficienza operativa, sicurezza e manutenbilità. Stabilire strutture operative, SOP e governance ben prima dell'apertura. Gestire gli abbonamenti dalla costruzione alle operazioni, compresi i fatturato phased. Per ogni progetto, identificare le necessità del personale e - in combinazione con le risorse umane- garantire la capacità operativa di nuovi asset. Stabilire programmi di formazione per la disponibilità operativa. 3. Post-Opening Operations Management Operazioni giornaliere dirette in tutti i dipartimenti (ospitalità, F&B, vendita al dettaglio, attrazioni, marine, sicurezza, manutenzione, servizi ospiti). Assicurare la consegna di esperienze, sicurezza, qualità dei servizi e standard di marca. Guidare la stabilità operativa durante le fasi di rampa e maturità. Condurre iniziative di miglioramento continuo attraverso il bene. 4. Forza di lavoro, formazione e cultura costruire, condurre e mantenere una forza lavoro multinazionale ad alto rendimento. Mantenere ed evolvere i programmi di formazione post-apertura. Integra una cultura orientata alla sicurezza e alle prestazioni. 5. Financial & Commercial Performance Own operativo P&L, controlli dei costi e metriche di produttività. Gestisci bilanci operativi, capex pianificazione e riserve del ciclo di vita. Collaborare con i team commerciali per ottimizzare i ricavi (F&B, retail, esperienze, escursioni a riva dove applicabile). 6. Compliance, Safety & Risk Management Assicurare il rispetto costante di tutti gli standard normativi, marittimi, sanitari, di sicurezza e ambientali. Guidare la preparazione di emergenza, la gestione delle crisi e la pianificazione della continuità aziendale. Servire come responsabile per gli audit e le ispezioni. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

In line with current and future tourism trends, the Shore Excursions Product Development Manager oversees product content and delivery, negotiates costs, and develops new tours to grow revenue and enhance guest satisfaction in specific geographical regions.

Your Impact

- Lead the development of innovative shore excursion products and manage the tour program for assigned regions.

- Source and procure high-quality excursions in line with seasonal demand and company standards.

- Monitor market trends, guest preferences, and potential risks to develop effective action and improvement plans.

- Analyze guest feedback and satisfaction scores to drive continuous product and service enhancements.

- Build and maintain relationships with up to 100 tour operators, overseeing a portfolio of 1,000+ tours.

- Negotiate contracts with suppliers, manage large-scale bids, and optimize costs to ensure profitability and efficiency.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Insurance, and Operations teams to ensure compliance and risk mitigation.

- Oversee product creation, feedback analysis, and product revamping to maintain competitive and engaging offerings.

- Ensure inventory accuracy and perform regular site inspections within assigned destinations.

- Represent the company at government meetings, industry events, and travel conventions to strengthen partnerships and brand presence.

Your Journey so far

- 10 years of experience in the Shore Excursions Department within the cruise industry (either onboard or ashore) is preferred. Experience in shore excursion operations within the hospitality industry or with a global tour operator may also be considered.

- 5–10+ years of proven experience in global shore excursion operations is required, including product development, bid management, and cross-functional collaboration with legal, insurance, and operations stakeholders.

- A bachelor’s degree in tourism and proficiency in multiple languages are highly preferred.

Your Essentials

- Flexibility and strong analytical skills.

- Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

- IT-savvy; experience with Fidelio is highly advantageous.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Publisher).

- Extensive knowledge of shore excursion products and operational delivery.

- Fluent in English with a good command of Italian; additional languages are an asset.

- Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time.

- Must hold an EU passport or have the legal right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Your Purpose Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. The role acts as business lead for lifecycle marketing and marketing automation, working in close partnership with Commercial, Digital, IT, Data and Legal teams to ensure scalable, compliant and high-performing customer communications. • Lead the definition of the global customer lifecycle strategy organizing the customer journey vision with Commercial, Digital and Guest Experience teams.

• Partner with IT, as technical owner, for architecture, integrations, security and scalability.
• Ensure operational excellence of automations, data flows and activation processes. 4. Data Governance & Compliance
• Define lifecycle communication standards in alignment with Legal and IT.
• Ensure consent management and subscription governance frameworks are operationalized within marketing automation tools.
• Support privacy-by-design principles across activation use cases. 5. Commercial Impact & Performance
• Define CRM contribution metrics and dashboards.
• Monitor engagement, retention and revenue influence.
• Provide optimization roadmaps to senior leadership. 6. Lead the development of a customer insights framework, leveraging CRM data, external ad hoc research to inform brand health evolution. Translate customer understanding into actionable growth opportunities. Partner with Guest Experience teams, Marketing and Commercial teams to design and prioritize customer research initiatives, including satisfaction tracking, journey analysis, loyalty drivers, brand tracking,etc. 7. Team & Capability Building

• Solid knowledge on global standards for data capture, consent management, governance, and enrichment
• Strong analytical mindset with experience translating CRM data into actionable insights. Experience leading customer insights initiatives such as segmentation studies, loyalty drivers, NPS/satisfaction research or journey diagnostics.
• Proven people manager, able to build, structure and develop teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.
• Strong track record of working hands-on while leading strategically, especially in complex or fast-growth environments.
• Experience managing agencies and external partners.
• Prior experience in luxury, premium or high-end consumer brands strongly preferred as well as Travel & hospitality Your Essentials
